raw_text: ALERT: Chinese state media CGTN and Global Times launching coordinated coverage of Manipur ethnic violence. Recycling old conflict footage from 2023 and labeling it as current events. Pro-PRC Telegram channels pushing narrative that India is a failing multi-ethnic state unable to protect minorities. Multiple accounts posting identical scripts about ethnic cleansing in Northeast India. This is clearly a coordinated information operation.
